records.prompt:
Edit target: the accepted cave-person character image.
Create the SAME character as a genuine transparent-background game cutout, preserving its identity, colors, contour, facial placement, messy brown hair, brows, small nose and mouth, short beard, ochre hide wrap with TWO dark patches, and single continuous rounded head-body. Do not redesign, reinterpret, add anatomy or change the expression.
Keep EXACTLY FOUR detached round tan limbs: left hand, right hand, left foot, right foot, matching the original. Ensure each of those four round pieces has a clear transparent gap of at least 25 pixels from the body and from every other piece so a game engine can animate them independently. The body, each hand and each foot should form five separate isolated cutout pieces in the SAME natural layout as the original: body centered, hands beside it, feet below. No connecting arms or legs and no new separate head or neck.
One complete character only, centered on a square canvas with comfortable transparent margins. Keep the existing flat 2D simple hand-ink style. Remove the pale background completely. Absolutely NO background color, checkerboard pattern, ground shadow, text, border, labels, weapons, extra body parts or duplicated character. Actual alpha transparency is required, including between all five pieces.

Edit target: the four dinosaur design sheet.
Convert it into a transparent game-sprite atlas of the SAME FOUR accepted dinosaur candidates, preserving each existing silhouette, proportions, colors, facial expression, feet, snout, horns/crests/plates and ONE tail. Remove ALL text labels and remove the background completely, preserving only the four actual dinosaurs.
Use a square canvas with FOUR equal 2x2 cells. Upper left: sage hunter theropod. Upper right: terracotta three-horn ceratopsian. Lower left: ochre/olive fantasy spitting dinosaur with two broad crests and round mouth. Lower right: slate-mauve low armored ankylosaur with three simple back scutes and a club tail.
Each whole dinosaur fits entirely inside its own cell with generous transparent margins and a wide clear transparent gap to all other cells. Keep heads facing in the same directions as the reference; do not add mirrored duplicates. All creature body parts stay naturally connected as in the design reference. No accessories, attacks, extra creatures, text, labels, borders, checkerboard pattern, scenery or cast shadows. Genuine alpha transparency is required throughout all empty areas.
Do not redesign or increase detail. Preserve the simple flat non-pixel hand-ink 2D game style, and exactly four dinosaur sprites only.

records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE genuine-transparent game weapon atlas, exactly SIX isolated weapon icons in a regular 3 columns by 2 rows grid, all six complete with generous transparent gaps and cell margins. No text or labels.
Reference 1: current cave-person scene and its three primitive weapon examples. Match their simple warm dark-brown hand-ink outlines and large flat color shapes. The new fantasy weapons are explicitly allowed by the user: a wooden gunpowder/rocket barrel launcher and a magic staff, keeping the same primitive visual language.
Canvas: landscape 3:2 with actual alpha transparency in all empty areas. Each weapon fits entirely within its own equal cell. No scene, ground shadows, borders, checkerboard, labels, extra icons or duplicates.
UPPER LEFT: short chunky wooden CLUB, one broad rounded brown head tapering to a wrapped simple grip. No spikes, at most one broad grain curve.
UPPER MIDDLE: STONE AXE, one compact broad gray stone head tied to a short warm wooden handle with two broad cream bindings, matching the existing sample.
UPPER RIGHT: BONE BLADE, a single curved broad ivory bone knife with one short dark brown wrapped grip. Readable crescent cutting silhouette, no fancy skull or tiny engravings.
LOWER LEFT: SLING, broad dark leather pouch with one pale stone seated in it and two short thick simple cords, matching the previous curved sling sample. Not a firearm, no thin tangled cords.
LOWER MIDDLE: WOODEN GUNPOWDER BARREL LAUNCHER: a SHORT stout horizontal wooden barrel with a large dark round forward muzzle, two dark broad binding bands and a small simple grip underneath. One tiny short warm-red fuse at the back. Clearly a wooden fantasy primitive rocket launcher, NOT a metal modern bazooka. Only 3 broad wood-stave divisions, no screws or intricate mechanisms.
LOWER RIGHT: MAGIC STAFF, a short rough dark wooden shaft with a simple forked curved cradle holding ONE rounded muted mint/teal magic stone. One broad ivory binding, no bright glow, particles, complex runes or ornaments. Clear long staff silhouette.
All six icons are compact and sized comparably for 2D overhead-game use, flat non-pixel illustration, low-saturation earthy brown/gray/ivory with restrained orange or mint accents. No 2.5D perspective, 3D volume, gradients, glossy rendering, cast shadows, microtexture or realistic weapon detail. Preserve all six in the exact listed cell order, exactly six icons, no extra character or creatures.
